source_shape: Broad shallow trapezoidal top at y7..11, two side-by-side low rectangular drawer fronts at y13..15, low rail at y17 and short outer feet at y19. Source has no visible books, papers, stacks or separate lamp.

palette.rule: Drawer fronts, housing, low rail and supports use primary w. The broad tabletop including its shallow front edge uses detail W. Gold top is an extraction aid; final layers are neutral.

donor_reference.role: Actual installed EndTable_south supplies wood-front shading, restrained drawer seams and crisp furniture contours. Its vertically stacked drawers, round knobs, footprint and donor gameplay are not copied.

construction: One editable spatial wood body, broad independent tabletop, two equal side-by-side inset fronts with recessed pulls, low rail and short supports. S has two drawers; E complete plain end; N plain back. W mirrors E because geometry and markings are symmetric.
native_state: Book Table inherits Furniture directly, not Table: no inherited EmptyTile/FullTile or alternate detail-color tags apply. One fixed source tile; native container/on inventory, non-solid80-weight non-takeable organic furniture and rare Animated builder remain native.

frame.rule: One full-cell transform for entire table and top ownership. Preserve source cell margins; do not fit/center drawers or tabletop separately.

native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation gate; fixed source container/on inventory, non-solid organic furniture, rare Animated fallback and extra-view placement remain unfinished.

directional_reference.missing: No explicit drawSize/size in inspected XML ancestry; runtime defaults not exported. Texture dimensions are not physical dimensions.
directional_reference.role: Actual directional VTE EndTable surfaces establish parallel top edges and shallow map-camera visibility with front drawer seams, blank side/back panels. No stacked donor drawers, knobs, gameplay or footprint copied.

camera.projection: screen u8+cardinal_horizontal, v18-height-0.475*cardinal_depth. Parallel axes, same object scale/pivot throughout; no perspective convergence.
camera.depth_status: Authored estimate for Qud hidden depth; broad source width and low drawer housing retained. Actual donor camera informs planes, not recovered dimensions.
camera.source_correction: Replace strongly converging trapezoid with rectangular tabletop in a fixed shallow cardinal map projection. Retain two side-by-side front drawers, low rail and short feet.
camera.unseen: Plain side/back wood with understated puzzle-box joinery seams; no extra drawers, books, papers, switches or visible inventory.
